demo_scenario.title: Two-founder private limited services company with one non-director employee
demo_scenario.purpose: Demonstrate the Central graph and its honest state/private gates without implying universality.
assumptions: Two adult Indian individual founder-subscribers are the only directors; both have valid PAN and at least one satisfies the 182-day India-stay rule.

The company is a private company limited by shares with authorised and subscribed capital of INR 100,000 split equally; no foreign investment, Section 8, producer-company or regulated-sector fact applies.

It supplies ordinary software/consulting services from Bengaluru, Karnataka, starts below INR 20 lakh aggregate turnover, has no presently identified compulsory GST-registration trigger, and will preserve a sections 22-24 classification rather than relying on turnover alone.
The registered office and correspondence address are the same; lawful occupation evidence, owner NOC if needed and a utility bill not older than two months exist.
A bank is selected only from the live AGILE-PRO-S form; post-referral KYC remains an action gate until the bank activates the account.

The founders are unpaid non-employee directors for headcount assumptions. The first and only worker is one Indian-resident, non-director software employee working in Bengaluru in a non-hazardous occupation.
The employee's gross salary is INR 150,000 per month in Tax Year 2026-27 and projected salary tax is positive; the exact TDS amount is intentionally not assumed.

The employee is not a person with disability. One non-hazardous worker is below the ordinary 20-employee EPF and 10-person ESI/OSH establishment thresholds; the MCA-issued identifiers are retained without contribution filings, and salary is not used to reach the ESI establishment result.
The workplace has fewer than 10 workers, so the district Local Committee route is used for POSH and no Internal Committee is claimed.

qualifier_answers.answer: Two Indian individual subscriber-directors; at least one satisfies the 182-day India-stay test.
Bengaluru, Karnataka; registered office equals correspondence address and evidence is ready.
A bank selected from the live AGILE-PRO-S list; exact bank not hard-coded.

Domestic software/consulting services, starting below INR 20 lakh; sections 22-24 and current notifications reveal no identified compulsory trigger on the stated facts, but the decision remains Action Required until the live case review.
Bengaluru, Karnataka; one worker; two founders are unpaid non-employee directors.
Establishment below 20 employees; preserve prior UAN facts but no contribution duty inferred.
INR 150,000 monthly wages, not disabled, Bengaluru; the one-person non-hazardous establishment is below ordinary establishment coverage, so no current wage-ceiling amount is assumed.
INR 150,000 monthly gross in Tax Year 2026-27; exact declarations and tax computation collected before payroll; positive TDS assumed only for demonstrating remittance.
One-worker workplace; official Bengaluru District Officer/Local Committee route must be obtained in the state-local addendum.

out_of_scope_facts: No foreign subscriber, foreign investment, Section 8, producer-company, public-company or regulated-sector approval.
No second state/workplace, factory, mine, dock, construction, contract-labour or hazardous occupation.
No assertion that Karnataka Shops and Establishments, professional tax, labour welfare fund, trade licence, minimum wage, leave, stamp or Local Committee details have been completed.
No exact MCA/bank/state fee, SLA, GST liability amount, salary TDS amount or annual corporate income-tax filing calendar is asserted.
action_required_gates: Live MCA fee/stamp calculation and payment must be accepted for the actual state/capital/forms.
The selected bank must complete current KYC and issue active-account proof before subscription funding.

A Karnataka/Bengaluru primary-source addendum must resolve Shops and Establishments, professional tax, labour welfare fund, trade licence, minimum wage/leave/hours, employment terms, stamp duties and the official POSH Local Committee route.
GST liability must be rechecked from actual supplies through sections 22-24 and current notifications immediately before incorporation and on each material change.

If ESI establishment coverage later applies, the current Chapter IV wage-ceiling notification must be obtained; saved Regulation 31 supplies the 15-day remittance deadline only while section 164 savings remain operative and must be rechecked for payments on or after 20 November 2026 or earlier replacement.
demo_scenario.non_universality_note: This scenario demonstrates one bounded low-headcount private-company services route. Any change in company form, founders, capital, state, work location, headcount, wages, prior membership, disability, hazard, supply or turnover must re-run the qualifiers and may activate different tasks.
